items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I belonged to David. I played for them. I used to play all their dances, all their balls, all their parades.

ctx.x: I belonged to David. I played for them. I used to play all their dances, all their balls, all their parades. You leave Benevolent Association, I played all their parades and all their dances and all their... All their barrails, all their funerals.
Anyway. Did you play very many funerals? How often did they have a funeral that way with music? Oh, not very often, no.
